cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cafe chair wobbles. Take it out of service, please; we diagnose the cause before we stuff paper under a leg.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested it. It's only this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the chair is a symptom. Lift the boards around it; I need to see the whole support, not one squeak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then change the sign to 'Closed for renovation.' With the floor exposed, I can move the counter and fix the queue. Print it clearly, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 diagnostic discipline, A3 support-versus-symptom correction and A5 readable closure notice make A professional authority widen a tiny fault into renovation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 one floorboard causes A3 surrounding boards; B4 deadline causes A5 closure and counter redesign.

relationship.evidence: B2 has tested the fault and B4 needs normal trading, so A overrides genuine practical limits.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 twenty-minute constraint to abandon opening and launch the larger queue-layout project.

specificity.evidence: A1 cafe spelling is now correct; chair, floorboard and opening time supply concrete stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 sign wording and print instruction act on the closure rather than repeat a breakfast maxim.
